The validate and hypothesize berths named here already exist on disk: the chart chain was run to completion on 2026-10-12 before this rehearsal (ls ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/ lists both files), so nothing is located at build time and no chart is run again. How each verdict field is filled: run the criterion's instrument exactly as written; outcome is "pass" when it exits 0 and its summary line reads '0 red' (for a curl instrument, when it prints 200 and a time under the bound), else "fail"; evidence is that summary line (or the curl output) copied verbatim; discriminating_observation is the red-first measurement already recorded in the red-first decision (what the same proof printed before the build). Each disposition is "confirmed" when the hypothesis's falsifier did not occur in those runs, else "killed", and by names the run that decided it. The PROVED crossing's why is 'verdict passing; proofs sealed; hollow 0'. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The berth paths named in the verdict decision are exact, not examples, and they persist: chart berths are instance-space records that nothing deletes (the chart doors only add), and 'ls ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/' listed both on 2026-10-12. The hypothesize path is also read from the validate berth itself: json.load(open(validate_ref))["hypothesize_ref"] names it. If either path does not open at build time, that is a refusal brought back verbatim, never a search for a substitute. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
